pages.text: Certus quartz buds will sprout from budding certus blocks, similar to amethyst. These are

found in $(l:ae2_mechanics/meteorites)meteorites$(/l). There are 4 tiers of budding certus blocks: Flawless, Flawed, Chipped, and Damaged. They can be most easily identified with a mod like HWYLA, Jade, The One Probe, etc. (or the f3 screen)$(br2)With flawed, chipped, and damaged budding certus, every time a bud grows by another stage, the budding block has a chance to degrade by one tier, eventually turning into a plain $(l:items_blocks_machines/quartz_block)Certus Quartz Block$(/l).

Flawless budding certus will not degrade from growing buds, and act as an infinite source.$(br2)If broken with a regular pickaxe, budding certus blocks will degrade by 1 tier. If broken with a pickaxe enchanted with silk touch, they will not degrade, unless they were flawless. $(bold)This means that flawless budding certus blocks cannot be picked up and moved with a pickaxe$(). Instead, $(l:ae2_mechanics/spatial_io)Spatial Storage$(/l) can be used to
cut-and-paste the flawless budding blocks around.

pages.title: Recipes
pages.text: Flawed, chipped, and damaged budding certus can be crafted by throwing the previous tier of budding block (or a $(l:items_blocks_machines/quartz_block)Certus Quartz Block$(/l)) in water with one or more $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal_charged)Charged Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l).$(br2)Flawless budding certus cannot be crafted, only found in the world.

pages.title: Throw in Water
pages.text: Throw the items into water together.
